contentText: A total of 32 Cuban nationals were killed during the US attack on Caracas that culminated in the capture of Venezuela's President Nicolas Maduro, the government in Havana said Sunday. US forces attacked Caracas in the early hours of Saturday, bombing military targets during a shock snatch-and-grab raid to remove Maduro from power and assert Washington's control over the oil-rich South American nation. Follow our liveblog for updates.
